Small but incredibly deadly. It previously belonged to a mysterious, masked nomad of the Aldecaldos clan.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Medium Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 (Biotoxin) • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon is considered to be permanently coated with Biotoxin. When attacking a target that was inflicted with a Critical Injury during the previous Round, the Resist Torture/Drugs Check for avoiding the damage from this weapon’s Biotoxin is increased to DV21.When attacking a target that took damage from any source of Poison and/or Biotoxin during the previous Round, this weapon’s Biotoxin can incur non-dismemberment Critical Injuries (Including Head Critical Injuries if this weapon successfully hit a target’s head via an Aimed Shot, otherwise it inflicts Body Critical Injuries) and when rolling for its damage, only a single 6 needs to be rolled for it to incur a Critical Injury.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
